new_contradictory_or_boundary_evidence: OASIS is not inference-only: it uses last-layer sample-wise gradients; the clean delta corrects the earlier worker claim and reports <3.5% backward overhead relative to a forward pass.
Plasticity preservation and forgetting prevention are distinct: selective weight reinitialization can stabilize plasticity yet may worsen forgetting without rehearsal/retention constraints.
More replay is not monotonically better; strong replay mechanisms coexist with formal/scoped evidence that random replay can increase forgetting.
High judge test-retest reliability can coexist with low validity or severe position bias; repeatability, correctness, invariance, calibration and instance uncertainty must remain separate.
A nine-judge panel can collapse to about two effective independent votes; judge count must not be used as a proxy for independent evidence.
Adaptive capping/Hyperband/FABOLAS show large source-domain evaluation savings, but low-fidelity correlation and late-bloomer false pruning are mandatory transfer risks for agent evaluation.
The mobile robotic chemist's sixfold activity improvement is objective-value improvement, not a sixfold experiment-count saving; do not conflate the two endpoints.
EWC and replay are real continual-learning mechanisms but neither is a universal solution; harder class-incremental regimes and frozen-feature confounds constrain transfer.

AutoResearchClaw verification removal can increase apparent acceptance while introducing fabricated numerical claims, demonstrating that surface-quality reward and evidence integrity can move in opposite directions.

Project-to-task contracts improve aggregate downstream execution in a small preprint but regress two of ten tasks and lack an equal-compute no-contract control; do not attribute the full gain to graph structure.
MARS now has stronger component ablations, while GEA remains a bundled parent-selection + experience-sharing intervention; cross-lineage sharing must not receive the full system-level credit.

GEPA repository evidence contains a validation-cache split-ID bug affecting the optimization/selection path; held-out outcomes remain observations but causal claims require split-safe rerun/configuration proof.
